limits: Ordinary portable MinGW frontend and its identified source host; remote Consolas grids only. This is not the single-image distribution or local 160x48 Sarasa acceptance. The roughly 50 MB total target applies to GDI; current DX memory is accepted. This image includes DECUDK, Locator, CAN/SUB parity, all 232 native UDK streams and 413 earlier reference streams. Full single-image acceptance is separate.
